description: stellarlib's own unified vocabulary: the unified fields and the physical parameters every data source maps into. Each library family's characteristics and its mapping into this vocabulary live in the family's data file models/<family>/unified_parameters.json next to its catalog.json; stellarlib.registry loads the definitions and every family file together and validates them as one registry. The human-readable document docs/unified-parameters.md is generated from the combined registry by tools/generate_parameter_docs.py; edit the JSON files, never there.

unified_fields.name: wavelength
unified_fields.description: wavelength of the sampling grid; the air/vacuum convention is the product's own (declared per family in notes) and is never converted

unified_fields.name: observed_flux
unified_fields.description: observed flux of an empirical library's star — relative, with an arbitrary per-star normalization (unitless); mapped only by empirical families and never onto or from the model flux fields

unified_fields.name: eddington_flux
unified_fields.description: the Eddington flux H_lambda as published — the first angular moment of the specific intensity

unified_fields.name: surface_flux
unified_fields.description: the astrophysical surface flux F_lambda = 4 pi H_lambda (4 pi * x)

unified_fields.name: continuum
unified_fields.description: the continuum level as published, same units as the flux

physical_parameters.name: teff
physical_parameters.description: effective temperature; the primary axis of every spectral library

physical_parameters.name: log_surface_gravity
physical_parameters.description: log10 surface gravity (same name and unit as stellariso, for cross-package consistency)

physical_parameters.name: m_h
physical_parameters.description: overall metallicity as [M/H] of the scaled-solar composition set

physical_parameters.name: microturbulence
physical_parameters.description: microturbulent velocity of the model atmosphere

physical_parameters.name: spectral_resolution
physical_parameters.description: the instrumental broadening the published sampling encodes

physical_parameters.name: composition
physical_parameters.convention: the library's own composition tag, verbatim
physical_parameters.description: composition selector of a per-composition product (TLUSTY tags)
